title: Prompt & Captioning Profile Engine
description: Canonical Prompt/Captioning profile manifest with P23.4 legacy migration aliases, persistence/replay compatibility, and completed Image/Video task taxonomy.

purpose.label: General / Balanced
purpose.description: Balanced visual description or prompt generation without a specialized training focus.

purpose.label: Character / Person Identity
purpose.description: Prioritize stable visible identity traits while keeping variable scene attributes distinct.

purpose.label: Pose / Body Position
purpose.description: Prioritize body orientation, limb placement, gesture, balance, and camera-relative pose.

purpose.label: Expression / Emotion
purpose.description: Prioritize visible facial expression, gaze, head angle, and observable affect without inventing a backstory.

purpose.label: Outfit / Clothing
purpose.description: Prioritize garments, materials, colors, layers, fit, footwear, and accessories.

purpose.label: Art Style
purpose.description: Prioritize visible medium, linework, rendering, shading, palette, texture, and stylistic treatment.

purpose.label: Concept / Theme
purpose.description: Prioritize the defining visible concept or theme while avoiding irrelevant detail.

purpose.label: Object / Product
purpose.description: Prioritize object shape, material, construction, surface, condition, and viewpoint.

purpose.label: Environment / Location
purpose.description: Prioritize visible architecture, terrain, room structure, weather, materials, and surrounding context.

visual_treatment.label: Source Accurate / Neutral
visual_treatment.description: Preserve the source visual treatment without intentionally restyling it.

visual_treatment.label: Photorealistic
visual_treatment.description: Use real-life photography and natural-material language.

visual_treatment.label: Cinematic
visual_treatment.description: Use filmic composition, lighting, lens, atmosphere, and color language.

visual_treatment.label: Candid / Documentary
visual_treatment.description: Use natural, unstaged, observational photography language.

visual_treatment.label: Editorial / Fashion
visual_treatment.description: Use magazine, fashion, styling, pose, and editorial photography language.

visual_treatment.label: Studio Photography
visual_treatment.description: Use controlled lighting, backdrop, and studio-photography language.

visual_treatment.label: Anime
visual_treatment.description: Use anime illustration terminology without changing unsupported source facts.

visual_treatment.label: Manga
visual_treatment.description: Use manga/comic rendering and line-art terminology.

visual_treatment.label: Watercolor
visual_treatment.description: Use watercolor medium, pigment, wash, edge, and paper-texture language.

visual_treatment.label: Oil Painting
visual_treatment.description: Use painterly oil, brushwork, impasto, canvas, and color-mixing language.

visual_treatment.label: Concept Art
visual_treatment.description: Use production/concept-design language focused on readable visual design.

visual_treatment.label: Fantasy Art
visual_treatment.description: Use fantasy-art treatment only as a requested visual treatment, never as invented subject lore.

visual_treatment.label: 3D / CGI
visual_treatment.description: Use 3D-render, material, lighting, and render-quality language.

visual_treatment.label: Graphic / Poster
visual_treatment.description: Use graphic-design, layout, poster, typography-safe, and compositional language.

grounding.label: Strict
grounding.description: Use only directly visible or explicitly supplied facts; omit uncertainty rather than guess.

grounding.label: Balanced
grounding.description: Stay factual while allowing cautious visual interpretation such as lighting quality or broad atmosphere.

grounding.label: Transformative
grounding.description: Allow requested visual-treatment and generation language while preserving source facts and never inventing concrete identity, relationship, or location claims.

analysis_scope.label: Person
analysis_scope.description: Focus on the visible person or people.

analysis_scope.label: Face
analysis_scope.description: Focus on facial appearance, expression, gaze, and visible head details.

analysis_scope.label: Outfit
analysis_scope.description: Focus on clothing, accessories, materials, and styling.

analysis_scope.label: Pose
analysis_scope.description: Focus on body position, gesture, orientation, and action posture.

analysis_scope.label: Environment
analysis_scope.description: Focus on background, architecture, terrain, room, and surrounding context.

analysis_scope.label: Composition / Camera
analysis_scope.description: Focus on framing, shot size, angle, perspective, lens feel, and camera placement.

analysis_scope.label: Lighting / Color
analysis_scope.description: Focus on light direction, quality, contrast, exposure feel, and palette.

analysis_scope.label: Action / Interaction
analysis_scope.description: Focus on visible actions and physical interactions between subjects and objects.

analysis_scope.label: Custom Crop
analysis_scope.description: Analyze only the user-selected image crop.

output_format.label: Image Generation Prompt
output_format.description: Prompt suitable for image generation or recreation.

output_format.label: Shot Breakdown
output_format.description: Structured camera, composition, subject, lighting, and scene breakdown.

output_format.label: Attribute List / Character Sheet
output_format.description: Structured visible attributes useful for character or reference analysis.

output_format.label: Dataset Caption
output_format.description: Grounded training caption optimized for dataset use.

output_format.label: Video Generation Prompt
output_format.description: Temporal prompt describing motion, continuity, and camera behavior.

output_format.label: Image Edit Instruction
output_format.description: Instruction prompt that clearly separates requested changes from preserved content.

output_format.label: Hybrid Prompt
output_format.description: Natural language with compact high-value prompt tags.

output_format.label: Structured Prompt
output_format.description: Sectioned prompt structure for advanced reuse.

prompt_task.label: Text → Image
prompt_task.description: Build an image-generation prompt from text/ideas.

prompt_task.label: Image Edit Instruction
prompt_task.description: Build a source-safe image-edit instruction from a text request without inspecting an image.

prompt_task.label: Text → Video
prompt_task.description: Build a temporal text-to-video prompt with motion, continuity, camera behavior, and an ending state.

preservation_policy.label: Preserve Unchanged Elements
preservation_policy.description: Treat all elements not requested for editing as preservation targets.

preservation_policy.label: Identity Priority
preservation_policy.description: Strongly preserve subject identity while permitting requested scene or styling changes.

preservation_policy.label: Composition Priority
preservation_policy.description: Strongly preserve pose, framing, camera, and scene geometry.

preservation_policy.label: Flexible
preservation_policy.description: Allow broader changes while retaining explicit source constraints.
